creator: Alexander Terp
description:
`docs/red/README.md` links twelve REDs. Three have no file behind them: RED-8 (Interactivity as a first-class capability, listed Implemented), RED-C (Own our interactivity layer, Draft), RED-D (One artifact for bundling and standalone executables, Draft). `git ls-files docs/red/` confirms they were never committed, so this isn't local drift.

`docs/red/STYLE.md` tells readers to study RED-C as the model for a live draft, so the style guide points at one of the missing files.

Worth folding two corrections back into `docs/VISION.md` while here: §5.4 and Appendix A both cite "RED-D stub" as an existing artifact, and §7 cites AI_POLICY.md as saying "verification over generation", a phrase that doesn't appear in it. The actual text (`AI_POLICY.md:15,22`) requires PRs be "fully verified with human-in-the-loop" - same spirit, but don't quote the invented version in public copy.

---

### Orientation

- REDs are decision records under `docs/red/`. `docs/red/README.md` holds the hand-maintained index table; the three broken links are `0008-interactivity.md`, `C-radish.md`, and `D-bundle-and-compile.md`. `git ls-files docs/red/` confirms nine committed documents plus `README.md`, `STYLE.md`, `template.md`, and `backfill-plan.md` - the three were never committed, so this is not local drift.
- The process is itself a RED: `docs/red/0001-red-process.md`. Read it first.
- `docs/red/template.md` is the skeleton to copy - YAML frontmatter (`red`, `title`, `status`, `kind`, `created`, `decided`, `released`, `supersedes`, `superseded-by`, `related`) then Summary, Context/Motivation, Decision, Rationale, Alternatives Considered, Compatibility & Migration, Other Consequences & Trade-offs, optional Future Directions / Open Questions / References, and a History list.
- `docs/red/STYLE.md` owns voice and prose. Note the circularity: STYLE.md:7 and STYLE.md:43 both direct readers to study RED-C as the model live draft, and RED-C is one of the missing files. Either write RED-C first or fix STYLE.md's pointer.

### Watch out for

`docs/` is not a snippet root - `core/testing/docs_snippets_test.go:42-45` covers only `docs-web/docs` and `core/error_docs`. Rad code in a RED is **not** executed by the test suite, so nothing catches a wrong example. Run anything you write through `./bin/radd` by hand.

RED-8 is marked Implemented in the index. Write it as the record of a decision already made, in past tense, with the Open Questions section empty - `template.md` says Open Questions should be heavy while Draft and empty by Implemented. Do not turn a backfill into a fresh proposal.
title: Write the three REDs that the index promises
